blocking_methods.label: alternate
blocking_methods.instructions: Call +91 22 6232 7777 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Log in to internet banking at https://www.rbl.bank.in and use the card block/hotlist option.

Block immediately via any channel: Website 'block your debit card using your CIF number'; Helpline +91 22 6232 7777; SMS to 9223366333 from registered mobile - Temporary Block: 'TBLOCK <last four digits of card> <Customer ID>' / Permanent Block: 'BLOCK <last four digits of card> <Customer ID>'; RBL MyBank app > Manage Your Cards > Block/Unblock Card > OTP; NetBanking > Requests > Block Debit Card; WhatsApp 'Hi RBL' to 84335 98888 > Banking Services.
